A standard Thai cuisine experiment everyone should come and enjoy and support NH Tien Tien Thai Cuisine.
Jun 2026 • Family
My family came to enjoy the traditional snack breakfast taste very elegant but very suitable for everyone.The next evening we went back to try the dish on the 1st floor in the Tien Tien Thai Cuisine it was surprising that the dish here is delicious and taste no place to get, the way the presentation of the dish is also beautiful and neat to stimulate when eating, the serving staff very careful to meet what the guests request.The restaurant has very delicious salmon taste in what is lost in Thailand.At the end of the afternoon I asked to learn that the owner in the restaurant imported flavours from Australia about so the dishes here are very clean and good for health, especially the vegetarian dishes here accounted for 30% of the 100 dishes in Tien Tien.
